title: Carry the v0.21.55 release record into candidates distilled onto v0.21.55
goal: The v0.21.55 tag commit adds releases/qualification/v0.21.55.json, and tests/release_records.rs (every_qualification_record_belongs_to_a_release_record, T-RELEASE54REC-1) requires releases/v0.21.55.json beside it. That record reached main only inside T-CLAUDEREL55REC-1, together with main's own 0.21.54 -> 0.21.55 version bump, which cannot compose onto the v0.21.55 tag (the base already carries the release version). So every candidate distilled onto v0.21.55 failed release_records (seen on v0.21.56-distilled-rc15's accept verification for T-CODEXRECORDS-1). This task gives the record its own labelled change: one commit removes releases/v0.21.55.json and the next adds it back byte-identical (sha256 checked), so local-distill composes it as a plain addition onto v0.21.55 while main's tip is unchanged. No test is changed.

results.before: candidate 4d32a8906 (v0.21.55 + 19 tasks): cargo test -p susi --test release_records: 4 passed, 1 failed (v0.21.55.json: no releases/v0.21.55.json for this qualified release)
results.with_record: the same tree plus main's releases/v0.21.55.json: 5 passed, 0 failed
results.main_tip: releases/v0.21.55.json on main is byte-identical before and after (sha256 recorded in the commit message)

limitations: Future releases distilled onto a released tag need the same: the release record of the base lands on main as its own task, never inside a main version bump.
